notes.title: ⚜️🕹️⚜️ Important Update on Steam Bundle Discounts ⚜️🕹️⚜️
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40290495/1e4c65ba09e41d37a1f467773c02d7e24b91e763.png

Dear Players,

Due to new Steam regulations, we must limit the discount on all our bundles to 10% to prevent an increase in the base price of our games (currently 2 USD without a discount). If the discount exceeds this limit, the bundles will no longer appear in the Steam store and will not be available for purchase. This change is necessary to keep our bundles accessible to you.

However, the discount on a bundle may fluctuate based on the number of discounts applied to the individual games within it. Be sure to follow our discount announcements so you don’t miss out on great deals!

Thank you for your support!

Best Regards

Cute Hanna Games


If you have one or several of our games, you can purchase our Bundle with a higher discount!)
